name: Doki-Doki High School Love Time
source:
A short typical Girl follows Boy set in a Typical Japanese high school. Follow Sachika as she attempts to get her feelings across to the boy of her dreams. A Studio Mugenjohncel NaNoRenO 2015 entry.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31521]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个典型的女孩跟随男孩的故事发生在一个典型的日本高中。跟随佐知花尝试向她的梦中男孩表达自己的感情。Studio Mugenjohncel NaNoRenO 2015作品。
